decisionsTitle: «Șterge» on a signed legal version retires and hides it; its text stays
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-09-29, from `/admin/legal`** — a screenshot of a group-run declaration's «Versiunile» table: version 1 «Înlocuită», «1 semnături · 0 evenimente · 0 înscrieri», its action cell reading «Nu se poate nici retrage, nici șterge: 1 semnături, 0 evenimente și 0 înscrieri depind de această versiune» — and: «aș vrea să pot șterge (cu dublă confirmare) chiar și documentele care sunt deja semnate».

**The rule that binds.** A signed version is the club's proof of what a person accepted: §556 stores the version, the moment and the text's hash on every acceptance, the signed PDF renders the text from the version's row, and AGENTS.md §10.8 forbids losing what was in force. So a version's text is never destroyed while a signature, an event or a registration depends on it. What the owner can have is the version out of his way.

**Decision — «Șterge» on a version with dependants is retire-and-hide** (amending §151, §418 and §556):

- **What it does.** One expand-only migration (`0114_legal_version_deleted`) gives `legal_documents` `deleted_at`, `deleted_by_staff_user_id` (FK `staff_users`, `SET NULL`) and `deleted_reason`, and a CHECK that a deleted row is also withdrawn and carries a reason. `deleteReliedOnVersion` sets the three and, in the same statement, `withdrawn_at` if it was not yet — so every reader that already skips a withdrawn version (the text in force, the effective dates the public cache waits for, the event editor's choices, the templates' «Șablon nou» and «Regenerează» comparison, the first notice that describes the list's states) skips it with no second condition. The row, the number and both texts stay; the acceptances keep pointing at it; the registration's page, the desk, the signed PDF and the version's own page read it by id and still find it.
- **Never in force again.** Not today, and not on a later effective date: a version approved ahead of its date and chosen by an event, deleted, stays out of force when its date comes (tested). No verb reaches a deleted version any more: withdrawal, approval, both real deletes and a second «Șterge» are refused (`deletionObstacle` gained `deleted`).
- **The numbering continues.** The row is kept, so `nextVersionNumber` counts it and the next draft never reuses a deleted number; nothing goes into `legal_document_numbering`.
- **Two confirmations, checked on the server.** «Șterge» on the row opens the version's delete screen, which asks in two steps: step 1 states the consequences with the real counts in words («1 semnătură, 0 evenimente și 0 înscrieri rămân valabile, iar textul rămâne în arhivă. Versiunea dispare din listă și nu mai poate fi pusă în vigoare.») and asks a required reason of 3 to 200 characters; step 2 asks the version's number typed by hand («6», a `v` in front forgiven) and carries «Șterg versiunea 6» with the bin glyph. The server checks the role first (the Administrator and the Superadministrator; the Organizer and the Tehnic role are refused), then the reason (refused naming «Motivul»), then the number (refused naming «Numărul versiunii», emptied and asked again), then the rule again inside the transaction. A page with two steps rather than a modal dialog, for §151's reasons: a refusal lands where the question is still shown, and the form works without JavaScript — then both steps are drawn together and posted at once.
- **The audit row** `legal_document_version.deleted` goes first in the transaction: the key, the number, the effective date, the approver, the hashes, the reason, the counts that stood on it (signatures, events, registrations, and for a terms version the registrations agreed inside its window) and `textKept: true` — never the text (§12.12). It is told apart from `legal_document.deleted`, which destroyed a version nothing relied on.
- **A version with no dependants keeps §151's real delete, as today**: the same screen with one confirmation — the typed phrase (`GDPR 2`) and a reason — and the number retired. «Șterge» there never hides instead: a version nothing depends on has no text to keep, and a press that finds nothing depending on it any more is refused with its own sentence so the screen offers the real delete.
- **The version in force is never deletable**, signed or not: approve the next version first. `removalPlan` asks it before the counts, so a version in force with signatures is refused as in force, with what to do.
- **«Versiuni șterse (N)».** Under each text's versions, a closed fold with the swept-bin glyph, read-only: the version, who deleted it, when, the reason, the counts and «Citește textul» to its page, which says it was deleted and why. Nothing is restored from it: a deleted version must never come back into force by accident, and the same words again are a new version («Versiune nouă» from its page), approved like any other.
- **The words.** The count line and every refusal sentence take each noun's form from the count by the site's no-ICU rule (`countForm`, §341): «1 semnătură», «2 semnături», «0 semnături», «20 de semnături», «1 eveniment», «1 înscriere»; English "1 signature". The row of a relied-on version now says «Nu se poate retrage: … depind de ea. «Șterge» o scoate din listă; textul rămâne pentru cine l-a semnat.»

**Refused.** Destroying a signed version's text, even behind a double confirmation — it is the club's proof. A restore button on the fold. Hiding a version nothing depends on instead of deleting it. The phrase `GDPR 6` as the second step — the page already names the text, and a number is what a thumb types on a phone. Ticking relied-on versions into the batch delete — they stay under «Rămân», pointing at the row's «Șterge».

**Consequences.** An event whose chosen declaration was deleted keeps pointing at it; what a participant signs is read by the event's kind of course, never by that id (§515), and the editor asks for a new choice. A privacy notice that described the public list's states, once deleted, no longer counts as the first such notice (§421), so registrants under it lose their stage on the public list — the error errs towards showing less.
changelogLine: - **«Șterge» on a signed legal version** — a version somebody signed, an event chose or a registration recorded can now be deleted from `/admin/legal` in two steps (the consequences with a reason, then its number typed by hand): it leaves the list for a closed «Versiuni șterse» fold and can never be in force again, while its text stays for every signature, the desk and the signed PDF; the counts say «1 semnătură», not «1 semnături». §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given an approved version that a signature, an event or a registration relies on, when it is deleted from `/admin/legal`, then its row, its number and its text in every language stay: every acceptance still points at it, and the registration's page, the desk and the signed PDF still read that text by id (`tests/integration/legal/delete-when-signed.test.ts`) (2026-09-29, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given an approved version that is not in force and that something relies on, when an Administrator presses «Șterge», then its screen asks in two steps — the consequences with the real counts and a reason of 3 to 200 characters, then the version's number typed by hand — and the server checks both: a missing or longer reason is refused naming «Motivul», a wrong number naming «Numărul versiunii», and nothing changes (2026-09-29, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given such a version deleted, then it is withdrawn and marked deleted with who, when and why; it is never listed among the versions, never offered to an event, never resolved as the text in force — not on a later effective date either — and never counted as «În vigoare» or «Înlocuită»; no verb reaches it again; and one audit row `legal_document_version.deleted` carries the key, the number, the reason and the counts, never the text (2026-09-29, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a text with deleted versions, when `/admin/legal` renders, then a closed fold «Versiuni șterse (N)» under its versions shows each one read-only — the number, who, when, the reason, the counts and a link to read its text — and restores nothing (2026-09-29, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a version nothing relies on, «Șterge» stays the real delete with the typed phrase and a reason; given the version in force, it is refused, signed or not; and a deleted version's number is never reused — the next draft continues the sequence (2026-09-29, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given the counts on a version's row, in a refusal or on the delete screen, then each noun takes its form from its count without ICU plurals: «1 semnătură», «2 semnături», «0 semnături», «20 de semnături», «1 eveniment», «1 înscriere», and "1 signature" in English (2026-09-29, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given an Organizer or the Tehnic role, when «Șterge» on a legal version somebody relied on is posted by any means, then the server refuses it before reading either answer, and nothing is written (2026-09-29, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: «Șterge» on a signed legal version: two steps, off the list into «Versiuni șterse», its text kept
